notes: Default-off advisory merge-group qualification policy (issue #5839). Enablement is #5881's operator action: it records owner, ceiling (dollarCeilingUsd + maxQualificationsPerDay), enabledAt, and expiresAt (at most 30 days after enabledAt) at enablement time. An absent, disabled, expired, or malformed policy behaves as disabled: a visible advisory summary note, no provider mutation, no qualification records, no advisory check assertion.
